title: AsdAIr Sonnet Browser Execution Packet
description: The durable handoff artefact between AsdAIr's planning half and Sonnet in Claude for Chrome, which is the Stage 1 live basket writer (see RUNTIME-DECISION.md, Warwick 2026-08-04). Produced by the product itself and stored in Postgres. NO Claude session constructs this by hand - on 2026-08-03 three plan files were hand-assembled, which is the failure this artefact exists to end. Lines MUST be pre-sorted by normalized brand A-Z then canonical product name A-Z, because that is the order Sonnet uses in ASDA and the ordering IS the speed. STATUS: schema only. The producer does not exist yet - WO-P.

shop_ref.description: e.g. SHOP-2026-08-03. Scopes every write back to one shop.

sort_contract.description: Declares the order the lines are already in. Present so a consumer can assert it rather than trust it.

expected_distinct_products.description: Reconciliation input (ruling section 3). A matching headline count alone is NOT sufficient proof - identity and quantity are checked per line too.

held.description: Lines deliberately NOT in the basket - ambiguous, out of stock, awaiting a decision, or excluded by rule. Present so nothing is silently dropped.

seq.description: Position in the Brand A-Z order. Sonnet works these in order.

original_list_line.description: What was actually written on the photograph. Never lost - it becomes the alias on write-back.

canonical_product_id.description: asdair.regulars.id. NULL only for a newly approved item that has no regulars row yet.

canonical_product_name.description: Looked up from OUR rows, never model prose.

brand.description: Drives the primary sort. NULL sorts last.

normalized_brand.description: Lowercased/trimmed sort key, so the order is reproducible rather than locale-dependent.

source_view.description: Where Sonnet finds it. 'search' is permitted ONLY when origin is new_approved - a known item must NEVER be free-searched.

asda_product_ref.description: ASDA product id. Required when origin is known.

required_quantity.description: Never invented. A list line with no written quantity defaults to 1 per the household's own standing rule.

origin.description: known = already in Regulars/Favourites. new_approved = genuinely new AND approved by Warwick this shop.

approved_search_term.description: Warwick's approved wording. Required when origin is new_approved. NEVER invented by the model.

substitutes_allowed.description: Per-product permission. NOTE: no adapter can enforce this automatically - substitution control is a human step before purchase in every runtime. See RUNTIME-DECISION.md.

applied_rules.description: asdair.rules ids that shaped this line - a multibuy round-up, a rotation, a map. Present so Warwick can see WHY a quantity or variant is what it is, and so a rule that never fires is visible. Directly serves the open defect D-2026-08-04-04.

quantity_rationale.description: Human-readable, e.g. 'list said 3; rule 37 rounds up to 4 for the any-2-for-X offer, 4th is the female variant'.

reason.description: Never 'substituted' - substitution is not a permitted outcome anywhere in this product.
